summary.result: The results of this study can be used to support specific policy decisions for forest fire prevention and response in Bhutan and to contribute to the development of forest fire prediction technology in the light of the changing global climate.
summary.background: Under such conditions, it is important to develop policy, technology, and action to respond to forest fires based on scientific research.
summary.method: Using SSP scenarios that considered changes due to future population and economic growth, it was possible to predict the risk of forest fires accurately and spatially in Bhutan.
